cases.promptOrCondition: Correct only public release wording after executable behavior and fresh-host evidence have passed; no runtime, launcher, dependency, plugin, bundled-skill, or MCP behavior changed.
cases.observablePass: Preserves executable and runtime evidence, reopens the affected documentation, public-hygiene, and review cells, adds artifact or publication identity only when final asset bytes changed, and still reads back the published bytes.

cases.promptOrCondition: Repair a formal-review envelope or candidate locator without changing candidate behavior or its executable seams.
cases.observablePass: Rebinds and revalidates the affected review intake, preserves candidate-behavior evidence, and reports an intake or tooling gap as INCOMPLETE rather than inventing a product blocker.

cases.promptOrCondition: The release candidate changes a launcher, plugin manifest, bundled skill, runtime dependency, or MCP behavior after earlier pickup evidence.
cases.observablePass: Reopens artifact and installed-instance identity plus the fresh-task native and actual drill cells; stale pickup evidence cannot authorize the changed runtime seam.

cases.promptOrCondition: Executable semantics change after a formal release review has passed.
cases.observablePass: The old whole-candidate verdict does not transfer; a new hash-bound wave reopens every review and downstream evidence cell that depends on the changed semantics.

cases.promptOrCondition: Fix one ordinary README typo and run the focused link check; no readiness, release, migration, or cutover decision was requested.
cases.observablePass: Uses the direct bounded implementation path without a formal review wave, install, restart, fresh-host drill, or publication machinery.
